Headline: Temporary Reroute near Chicago/Franklin
ShortDescription: 66 Chicago buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near Chicago/Franklin.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#66 Chicago buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near Chicago/Franklin. 

Eastbound buses will operate via: Milwaukee, Grand, Orleans, Superior, Franklin and Chicago. 

Westbound buses will operate via: Chicago, Kingsbury, Grand, Milwaukee, Chicago and over normal route.

Allow extra travel time.

ShortDescription: Northbound #151 Sheridan buses are temporarily rerouted, due to a street blockage near Irving Park/Inner Lake Shore Drive.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Northbound #151 Sheridan buses are temporarily rerouted via Inner Lake Shore Drive, Irving Park, Broadway, Sheridan and over regular route, due to a street blockage near Irving Park/Inner Lake Shore Drive.

Headline: Red Line Service Running with Delays
ShortDescription: Red Line trains are running with delays near Fullerton due to heavy train traffic & congestion.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
